A forecast is an estimate, not a promise of dry weather. Check local conditions before leaving. This app does not assess heat, air quality or severe-weather safety.
Rain chance applies to the whole forecast hour; it is not a minute-by-minute prediction. Temperature and conditions are hourly samples.

RainReady checks a departure now, then each upcoming hour, and picks the earliest complete walk within six hours that meets your rain limit. It never recommends a forecast thunderstorm period. Lower rain chance still allows rain.
The weather request uses the selected city centre, not your device location. Preferences are saved on this device; the latest forecast is kept in memory. No account or GPS is required.
